title: Beads adapter: Unix test for npm-symlink resolution through canonicalize
outcome: Review round 14 (Claude Note, test gap). beads_native_beside has two resolution paths: the sibling node_modules/@beads/bd/bin layout (Windows npm launcher) is tested; the fs::canonicalize(launcher) path - a Unix npm symlink into the package bin directory, resolved to the native binary beside the symlink target - is not exercised by any test. That path decides the production binary on Linux and macOS. Follow-up: a #[cfg(unix)] test that symlinks bd to a bd.js file with a shebang, places a native stand-in beside it, and asserts resolve_beads_binary_on_path / beads_native_beside return the native binary (and that a shebang stand-in is rejected). Not written on the Windows host because it could not be run there; an unrun test is not evidence.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 3b, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-OBSOLETE. Beads was removed from the repository on 2026-10-03; no "beads" remains in src/work_*.rs on master.
